title: Ricardo Gill — Digital forensics incident analysis and historical research
author: Ricardo Gill
research_status: Plausible evidence-management application; not an automated verdict system

finder_profile.audience: Digital forensics incident analysis and historical research researchers, developers and evaluators
finder_profile.required_capability: Read original sources, design controlled tests, retain provenance and distinguish proposals from findings.

possible_application: Organise incident records around event, receipt and access times with preserved provenance. Explain the difference between evidence supporting past access and evidence discovered after the incident.
illustrative_example: A log recovered after an outage records an earlier alert. Determine what the log supports without assuming every operator saw it.
evaluation_targets: Timestamp interpretation, chain-of-source fidelity, contradictions and unsupported attribution.
requested_contribution: Read, test, adapt or critique the authored research; report methods, source version, comparisons, results and limitations.
source_relation: Related sources establish background problems or methods, not independent validation or endorsement of GCI.
